title: Realize compatible affine coherent cohomology as an etale module higher image
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, $E$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $q\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. For each affine etale $v:V\to S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], set $X_V=X\times_SV$, with projections $f_V:X_V\to V$ and $j_V:X_V\to X$, and $G_V=j_V^*G$ [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-module-pullback]. Suppose given $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$-linear bijections
$$e_v:H^q(X_V,G_V)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(V,v^*E)$$
[pqf-def-cohomology], such that for every arrow $h:V'\to V$ between affine etale $S$-objects one has $e_{vh}\circ h_X^*=\rho_h\circ e_v$. Here $h_X:X_{V'}\to X_V$, $h_X^*$ is the module cohomology pullback with its canonical coefficient identification [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap], and $\rho_h$ is the tensor-section restriction of [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Use the common coefficient universe of [def-weil-size-convention], with the same sectionwise additive lift $L=\operatorname{ULift}$ on all associated etale sheaves. Then there is an isomorphism
$$\Phi:R^qf_*L(G_{\mathrm{et}})\xrightarrow{\sim}L(E_{\mathrm{et}})$$
of $L(\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}})$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. The left hand side is computed in abelian sheaves, with the scalar action induced by multiplication by pullbacks of base functions, rather than an independently chosen action. Its normalization is as follows. Write $P(V)=H^q(X_{V,\mathrm{et}},L((G_V)_{\mathrm{et}}))$, and let $\iota_V:P(V)\to(R^qf_*L(G_{\mathrm{et}}))(V)$ be the canonical cohomology class map into the associated sheaf. For every affine $v$ and $x\in P(V)$,
$$\Phi_V(\iota_V(x))=\operatorname{ULift.up}\bigl(e_v(c^q_{X_V,G_V}(x))\bigr),$$
where $c^q$ is the simultaneous canonical comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-cohomology-comparison-pullback]. Equivalently, for $z\in\operatorname{Hom}((f^{-1}\mathbf Z[V])[0],L(G_{\mathrm{et}})[0][q])$, with $\mathbf Z[V]$ the free abelian representable followed by sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification, lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison], use $x=c_{\mathrm{raw}}(z)$ from [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map] and use the canonical raw class in place of $\iota_V(x)$. The same $\Phi$ intertwines all local multiplications by all base sections on every etale object, including non-affine objects.
